compactHeaderMeasurements.interpretation: Observed transition lies between 340 and 350 CSS px in these samples; exact CSS breakpoint is not inferred. Current implementation behavior is evidence, not approval of a two-row compact design. NAV-005 option A approves a one-row composition; behavior when the items no longer fit remains pending.

stylesheetReview.limitation: Rendered geometry was measured only in dark mode to avoid changing the persisted theme preference.

calculation.method: Marca mínima = 73,5 + 9 + 75,9 = 158,4 px. Ações rotuladas = 74,1 + 8 + 44 = 126,1 px; acrescentar gap do header 8 e padding total 28: 320,5 px, arredondado para 321. Em icon-only: ações 44 + 8 + 44 = 96 px; total 158,4 + 96 + 8 + 28 = 290,4 px, arredondado para 291.

followUpValidation.interpretation: Current production layout wraps through 340 px at sampled widths and uses 40 px high theme and 40 × 40 px menu targets at <=380 px. Measurements validate current behavior, not proposed design. Corrected recommendation: retain the theme label from 321 px; switch to icon-only at 320 px and below. Icon-only one-row composition is feasible from about 291 px; below that, allow two rows. These are calculated targets, not observed product behavior or CSS breakpoints.
limitations: No live light-theme geometry capture; only CSS declarations reviewed for the light variant.
The proposal still requires a product implementation and a separate runtime check afterward.
No product code or user preference was modified.

diagnosis.exactUiErrorSource: /api/admin-bootstrap non-2xx; the client currently maps all non-2xx statuses to the same generic administrative-data message

serverStatuses.401: Netlify Identity did not resolve an authenticated user
serverStatuses.403: Identity user exists but lacks administration permission

diagnosis.loginOrdering: Browser login awaits Identity, obtains the JWT, writes the auth cookie, emits the login event, then returns the user for the form handler.
diagnosis.overlap: Both the auth listener and form submit handler call showUser(user); adminDataPromise coalesces the bootstrap request, but both continuations may call loadSettings.
diagnosis.assessment: A UI overlap exists, but a simple bootstrap-before-cookie race is weakened by the observed order and single-flight bootstrap. Transient disagreement between browser identity and Netlify function identity context remains possible, as does an Identity outage; neither is proven.
diagnosis.nextSignal: Record bootstrap status, elapsed time, and request ID without user data or credentials on a future occurrence. No diagnostic instrumentation was deployed.
